claims.text: AI systems are not intrinsically intelligent; their complex abilities come from toolkits and ready-made solutions.
InstinctGPT comparisons showed that a 3B model with external runtime can boost performance but cannot compensate for fundamental model limitations.
Older models were trained on broad data without clear purpose, while modern models aim to extract more from fewer parameters and are sometimes specialized for tasks.
User U1 observed a person repeatedly playing piano at full volume, listening to metro announcements, and making micro sounds near a shower.
U1 described encountering the same person twice in the same bus, noting the person 'sprays gas' the second time.
U6 felt the air feeling like impending rain, possibly a lava-like rain based on temperature.
Someone claimed the fee for a diploma cover is 650 (currency unspecified).
Another user reported paying 47 for the same.
A third participant mentioned a fee of 30 hryvnias.
U1 suggested giving the cover away because it ends up as waste paper.
U8 argued that no one will take the cover and it will be seen only three times in a lifetime.
